easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Yedora triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Skirk Prospector enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Skirk Prospector by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Skirk Prospector face-up.
Repeat.
